name: PR detail Overview offers the PR Brief and a Files changed link opens a collapsed doc
description: From PR #482, the Overview tab shows the 'Generate brief' button (no brief stored in the seed, and no model call is made), then the same PR is reopened at ?tab=diff&file=docs%2Frate-limiting.md&line=3: the docs group is collapsed by default, so seeing the doc's seeded line proves the target group and card were opened (AC-57). The repo id is not known to the flow, so the target is applied by setting location.search on the current PR URL. AC-61 (browser Back returns to Overview) is not asserted here because agent-browser 'back' was not available when this flow was written; it is proven in the manual S21 demo. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
Overview offers to generate the brief (AC-37)
follow a Files changed link to the collapsed docs file
diff tab is active in the URL
the collapsed docs group opened and shows the targeted line (AC-57)
